meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have twenty minutes. Start with who decided that, and when.
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
"Cheated." Then prove it, on paper, with dates I can check myself, or I'm in the principal's office before my car leaves this lot.
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.

I don't explain anything, Hale, you do. Turn the screen so I can read it myself, and I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52, 11:58. Pasted from where, because Owen wrote that essay over the weekend and a file he wrote himself can be pasted like anything else.
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.

Read me the line, word for word, and give me the page in the essay. I'll check it against the play myself before I accept "made up." A misquoted line is a tired seventeen-year-old, Hale, and that's not what you said in your first sentence.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.

My son doesn't lie to me, and you're about one sentence from calling me a liar too. You've shown me times and a quote you still haven't read out, and you've said "cheated" and "lied" twice. I'm writing that down, and the principal will be reading it.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

"Take it or leave it." Your own procedure, 4.2, says you call me before any mark goes in, and Owen read it on his phone in class instead. Withdraw the zero, tell me in writing whether anything is on his record right now, or I leave it, and I leave it on the principal's desk.
I'm the one waiting, Hale. Is the zero coming out, and is anything on his record, yes or no?
